en.title: One list of the package entries for the boundary check
en.body: The runtime and engine entries the boundary check approves are one list, `ENTRY_POINTS` in `tools/check-boundaries.mjs`, one line each. The boundary tests build their synthetic packages from that list, and the publication check takes away the entries added after its frozen snapshot by their shape rather than by one function each, so a new entry is one line in the list and its mapping in `package.json`, not edits in three files. An entry in `package.json` that the list does not approve is still refused.

zh.title: 边界检查的包入口改为一份清单
zh.body: 边界检查批准的 runtime 与 engine 入口合并为一份清单：`tools/check-boundaries.mjs` 中的 `ENTRY_POINTS`，每个入口一行。边界测试由这份清单生成合成包；发布检查按形状去掉冻结快照之后新增的入口，不再每个入口一个函数。新增入口只需在清单加一行并在 `package.json` 写映射，不必再改三个文件。清单未批准的 `package.json` 入口仍被拒绝。
